# open-ucp: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP 1.0.0)

> Reference implementation of Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) & Agentic Purchasing (AP2 / X402) in TypeScript and Python with zero runtime dependencies.

## Entity Trust Graph
- Organization: Nymrel
- Parent Entity: JalenBuilds LLC
- Contact: contact@jalenbuilds.com
- Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/open-ucp
- Protocol Version: UCP/1.0.0

## Core Protocol Architecture

### 1. Discovery Manifest (`/.well-known/ucp.json`)
Autonomous AI purchasing agents discover merchant capabilities, parent legal entity trust, supported payment rails (x402, AP2, Stripe), and API endpoints:
- `catalog`: Product list with Schema.org JSON-LD microdata
- `negotiate`: Programmatic machine quote negotiation
- `checkout`: Autonomous checkout and settlement verification
- `verifyPayment`: Payment challenge proof verification

### 2. Machine Negotiation (RFC-UCP-002)
- Input: `QuoteRequest` `{ sku: string, quantity: number, agentId: string, clientNonce: string, proposedPrice?: number }`
- Calculation: Tiered volume pricing + dynamic margin curve with floor enforcement.
- Output: `SignedQuote` signed with HMAC-SHA256, TTL expiration, quote ID, and settlement instructions.

### 3. X402 Payment Protocol (RFC-X402)
- HTTP Status: `402 Payment Required`
- Response Headers: `X-402-Version`, `X-402-Pay-To`, `X-402-Amount`, `X-402-Currency`, `X-402-Network`, `X-402-Quote-Id`, `WWW-Authenticate`
- Authorization Header: `Authorization: X-402 <token>` or `X-402-Authorization: <token>`
- Settlement Receipt: `X-402-Receipt: <receipt_id>`

## Packages & Usage

### TypeScript / Node.js
```typescript
import { createUCPAppRouter, ProductCatalog, createDefaultManifest } from '@nymrel/open-ucp';

const catalog = new ProductCatalog();
catalog.addProduct({
  sku: 'api-service-01',
  title: 'AI Data Service',
  description: 'Real-time data feeds',
  basePrice: 1.00,
  currency: 'USD',
  unit: 'call',
  stockStatus: 'in_stock'
});

export const { GET, POST } = createUCPAppRouter({
  manifest: createDefaultManifest({ name: 'My Service' }),
  catalog,
  secretKey: process.env.UCP_SECRET_KEY || 'secret_32_bytes'
});
```

### Python / FastAPI
```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from open_ucp import UCPFastAPIMiddleware, ProductCatalog, ProductOffer, create_default_manifest

app = FastAPI()
catalog = ProductCatalog()
catalog.add_product(ProductOffer(sku="api-01", title="API", description="API", base_price=1.00))

app.add_middleware(
    UCPFastAPIMiddleware,
    manifest=create_default_manifest(name="My Service"),
    catalog=catalog,
    secret_key="python_secret_32_bytes"
)
```
